---
title: "A metadata file overrides the per-language block of the front matter"
toc: true
lang: fr
language:
  fr:
    toc-title-document: "Sommaire du document"
metadata-files:
  - _metadata-files-language.yml
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['<h2 id="toc-title">Contents from the metadata file</h2>']
        - ['Sommaire du document']
---

## Section

The front matter sets `toc-title-document` under `language: fr:`.
The file in `metadata-files` sets `toc-title-document` as a plain key under `language`.
Quarto merges the metadata file after the front matter, so its value must win.
